title: Firing a gun without wasting the shot
target: How to get a shot on target in R.E.P.O. given that each gun has its own build-up, spread, recoil and battery use.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Charge in it if it needs any
A clear line to what you are shooting at

steps.do: Learn whether your gun builds up before you need it in a hurry.
steps.because: a gun records whether it has a build-up and how long that takes (hasBuildUp)

steps.do: Close the distance rather than firing across a room.
steps.because: a gun carries its own random spread (gunRandomSpread)

steps.do: Expect the shot to move you as well as the target.
steps.because: recoil and camera shake are settings on the gun (gunRecoilForce)

steps.do: Watch the battery as well as the rounds.
steps.because: some guns drain a battery, including a full bar (batteryDrainFullBar)

steps.do: Do not treat two guns as interchangeable.
steps.because: each gun carries its own firing numbers (ItemGun)

commonMistakes: Firing from across a room and missing.
Ignoring the battery until the gun stops.
Assuming every gun handles the same way.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
